body:
Count On, Count Back: 1. 11. 2. 9. 3. 8. 4. Start with 9, the bigger number; then you only count on 5 (or: it is faster, with fewer counts).
Apple Orchard Story Problems: 1. 13 (8 + 5 = 13). 2. 8 (12 - 4 = 8). 3. 13 (6 + 7 = 13).
Make Your Own Story Problem: the story has a starting amount and an amount that joins or goes away, and the number sentence and answer match the drawing (for example, 5 birds and 3 more come: 5 + 3 = 8).
Adding and Taking Away Check: 1. 13 (9 + 4 = 13). 2. 9 (15 - 6 = 9). 3. 12 (7 + 5 = 12). 4. 14. 5. 15.
Scoring tip: a right answer with no picture, counters or number sentence is Got it! on solving and Not yet on showing. A student who writes 15 + 6 = 21 for problem 2 chose the wrong operation; reread the story with them and act it out.
title: Answer key: Adding and Taking Away Within 20
